description: Spanish claim form: fields are named by their printed Spanish captions. The ruled grid of the whole page is a form layout, not one table twenty columns wide and clipped on the right (#281). Each box is named by the caption printed with it: the sex boxes (M, F) and the relationship row ("La misma persona") print their label before the box, and the seven programme boxes of item 1 each take their caption and the hint under it (#281). Only the record of services stays a table: its header row over six lines, each followed by its shaded NPI subrow.
